note: TAGS2 DRAFT (exploration 2026-11-28; not frozen until the owner says 'TAGS2 go'). Journal-only would-skip scoring of tonight's surviving shadow ideas: NO order, slot, latch or halt change; computed after the close from the journals (as TAGS1). Thresholds copied from exploration/findings/*.md and fixed before any 11-30 data exists. Scored ONCE after 20 sessions. Educational only - not financial advice.
half_day_note: 2026-12-24 is a half day: reported separately, included in totals

BASKET5X.desc: a setup's 6th and later lots of the session (entry order, per account)
BASKET5X.scope: all non-Graveyard accounts; Primary reported separately
BASKET5X.test: EXCESS over an exposure-matched random cut drawn by whole setup-days (day-block), not saving vs actual

GAPU_GD25.desc: gap-down-family short (L3*, RW1/3/5/7*, RW3S*, CWT09-gapdn*) on a day SPY opened >= +0.25% above the prior close

PLOCK25.desc: lots entered after the account's closed day R >= +0.25 x its expanding daily sd (shifted one day)
PLOCK25.test: random skip of the same lot count AND the first-N path control; also report the change in average green-day size

SIDE20.desc: lots of one side entered after that side's closed day R <= -20R x (account lots/day / Primary lots/day), on top of a simulated -2R per-setup latch where the account has none
SIDE20.test: day-clustered neutral (account-mean re-pricing) t >= 2 AND same-day neutral >= 0; TT control dropped (reviewer)

BS30.desc: lots entered after the account's stop count for the day >= 30 x (account lots/day / Primary lots/day), same latch base as SIDE20

LONGF1.desc: long lot with prior-day close > +1% and stop >= 12 spreads
LONGF1.test: against F5 (stop >= 12 spreads only) on the same days, single stocks and inverse/vol ETFs split

score.bar_t: max(2.0, sqrt(2 ln 7) = 1.97) = 2.0 on day-clustered t (exploratory; any pass is a candidate for a pre-registered bench test, never an adoption by itself)
score.always_report: R after costs (LR8) of tagged lots vs untagged; percentile vs the rule's control (2,000 draws); avg R w/o best day and best-day share; per-setup and per-family better / worse counts (remedy rule); lots per day; the ledger rule changes inside the window
